# PURIST: Business Automation & AI Agent Agency | Worldwide

> PURIST builds and deploys production-grade workflow automation and AI agents for SMBs and scaling companies worldwide. We specialise in n8n, Make, Zapier, and Claude AI agent deployments across 171+ professions in 13 industry categories: home services, healthcare, agencies & consulting, real estate, food & restaurant, e-commerce, education, travel, legal, automotive, beauty & wellness, creative, and B2B services.
>
> Founded in London. Serving clients across the United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Spain, Netherlands, Ireland, and across the European Union, Latin America, and beyond. 500+ production workflows deployed globally. 99.97% uptime across all managed systems.

## About

PURIST is not a software platform. It is a specialist automation engineering firm that designs, builds, monitors, and maintains production-grade automation systems for businesses. Every deployment includes error handling, idempotency, monitoring, retry logic, documentation, and an SLA. Deployments are fully remote, and we work with clients across every timezone and industry.

Primary services: workflow automation, AI agent deployment, operations stack design, CRM data quality automation, free industry-specific automation guides.

PURIST serves clients as: automation agency (UK), business automation company (US), workflow automation agency (EU/LatAm), n8n agency, AI agent agency, no-code automation consultant, Make.com agency, Zapier alternative agency, agence d'automatisation (FR), agencia de automatización (ES).

## Technology Stack

- Workflow orchestration: n8n (self-hosted), Make (Integromat), Zapier
- AI inference: Claude by Anthropic
- State management: Redis, PostgreSQL
- Monitoring: Custom Grafana dashboards, Slack alerting, SMS on-call
- Deployment: Vercel, self-hosted VPS (Hetzner, DigitalOcean, AWS, GCP), Caddy reverse proxy with automatic TLS
- Integrations: HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Notion, Airtable, Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Xero, QuickBooks, Calendly, WhatsApp Business
